lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Okay, weekly sync. I posted the prep brief in the channel ten minutes ago, so let's go through it instead of doing status from memory.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: First goal from the design review: connectors end to end on real data. That's done. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub, Gmail and Drive all ran in one brief, and the connect page works for Google and GitHub.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Nice. On my side, the brief says Slack is not started, but that's outdated. The Slack wrapper is merged on main now. Posting to channels and DMs both work.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Yeah, and I hooked the meeting prep bot onto it. You tag agent, generate meeting prep, and it posts the brief in the thread. It worked in test-bot-features today.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: One problem: we had two processes listening on the same Slack app, so mentions got split randomly. We need one host for the bot.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Agreed, I'll host it for now. Michael, can you add a proper router so one listener handles prep, join and wrap up commands? Let's say by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Sure, Wednesday works.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: My item, the after-meeting spec, is still not in Drive. Honestly the after stage already exists in PR one, so I'd rather document what's built than write a spec from scratch.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: That makes sense. So George turns the after README into the spec and adds the open scope questions. Can you do that by Monday?

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: Monday, yes.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: For recording the meeting itself we tried Fireflies. The API works, but the bot didn't record our test call, it ended up on the wrong account I think.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: Let's still go with Fireflies, the free plan has an API. Recall is paid.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Decision then: Fireflies is the recorder for the meeting stage. I'll make sure the Fireflies transcript flows into the after stage automatically, by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Also the Codex summarizer still returns 401. Do we care?

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Not for the demo. Claude Code is the default backend. We'll leave the Codex issue open.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: What about aggregating everyone's briefs? We said shared folder last time.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Still the plan, but nobody owns it yet. Let's leave that open and pick an owner next week.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Someone also needs to rehearse the demo end to end before Friday.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Agent, please schedule a demo rehearsal with all three of us on Thursday at 3pm for 45 minutes.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: And agent, make a one page visual report of this meeting for the channel.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: Last thing, we should buy a custom domain for the demo landing page.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Agent, find someone who can register a domain for us, but don't buy anything without approval.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Goals for next week: one Slack listener with a command router, Fireflies transcripts flowing into after automatically, the after spec in Drive, and a full rehearsal done.

lines.speaker: Taufiq
lines.text: Thanks everyone.
